## David Hume on experience

David Hume (1711–1776) approaches experience within Empiricism. All ideas derive from impressions; meaningful philosophy traces terms to experience. Causation is constant conjunction plus customary projection, not perceived necessary connection. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets experience most directly—useful for searches such as “david hume quotes on experience.”
